result.reason: The draft supplies the fallback durations and remedies, but the software warranty is limited to conformity "in all material respects," so it does not fully meet the unqualified fallback conformance requirement. The preferred durations, compliance-with-laws warranty, and malicious-code warranty are also absent. In addition, the malformed reference to "ARTICLE VIX" creates uncertainty as to whether the broad disclaimer effectively carves out the new express warranties.
